articles.title: Ethereum Foundation lays out use cases for governments, institutions in new policy guide
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation said policymakers should distinguish between decentralized public blockchains and networks that remain controlled by corporations or foundations, arguing that governance structures will play a critical role in determining which platforms are suitable for long-term public sector use.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks above $60,000 after Fed Chair Warsh said inflation risks has come down
articles.snippet: The Fed chair reiterated the central bank's commitment to its 2% inflation target while signaling artificial intelligence could reshape the economy and monetary policy.

articles.title: What's next for Bitcoin and stocks? Analysts see a volatile second half
articles.snippet: After AI drove equities higher while bitcoin lagged, market watchers expect macro policy and market structure to take center stage.

articles.title: Circle CEO touts USDC's network advantage as OUSD emerges
articles.snippet: Bernstein said OUSD could become the strongest new challenger to the Circle-Tether duopoly, while flagging unresolved questions around governance, operations and revenue sharing.

articles.title: Crypto companies have spent $189M so far on 2026 US election cycle: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto industry, Big Tech and gambling interest groups are betting big on politicians in the 2026 primaries and elections, with almost $300 million shelled out so far.
